articles.headline: McKinsey: Medtech needs more than a market rotation to win back investors
articles.summary: McKinsey argues that medtech's failure to re-attract institutional investors stems from structural issues — weak growth credibility, reimbursement uncertainty, and thin margin profiles — rather than macro headwinds alone. The piece outlines what medtech companies must demonstrate to merit re-rating beyond simply benefiting from a favorable rate environment. It provides a framework for distinguishing durable compounders from names relying on multiple expansion.
articles.why_it_matters: For investors with medtech exposure (e.g., ISRG), this framework helps identify which names have the structural characteristics to sustainably re-rate versus those vulnerable to continued institutional skepticism.
